pages.caption: Word Search
pages.title: Word Search Maker
pages.blurb: A free word search generator you can fill with your own words. Type any list into the box, pick a grid size and difficulty, and a fresh printable puzzle builds instantly — with a matching answer key you can show or hide.
pages.tip: Editing the word list rebuilds the grid. Spelling words, vocabulary, party names — anything you type gets hidden in the letters and marked correctly on the answer key.

pages.caption: Printable Word Search
pages.title: Printable Word Search
pages.blurb: A ready-to-print word search with a clean grid and a word bank underneath. Print it as-is, or swap in your own words first — no download, no signup, and the answer key prints on its own page.
pages.tip: Great for classrooms and rainy afternoons. Bump the grid to 20 x 20 and turn on backwards words for older solvers, or keep it at across-and-down for beginners.

pages.caption: Christmas Word Search
pages.title: Christmas Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable Christmas word search packed with holiday words — Santa, reindeer, stockings and more. Print it for a party, a classroom, or a quiet December afternoon, with an answer key ready when you need it.
pages.tip: Want it easier for little ones? Switch difficulty to across-and-down and drop to a 10 x 10 grid. You can also edit the word list to match your own family's traditions.

pages.caption: Halloween Word Search
pages.title: Halloween Word Search
pages.blurb: A spooky printable Halloween word search — pumpkins, witches, ghosts and skeletons hidden in the grid. Print copies for a class party or trick-or-treat downtime, answer key included.
pages.tip: For a creepier challenge, turn on backwards and diagonal words. For younger kids, keep it across-and-down and shrink the grid to 10 x 10.

pages.caption: Thanksgiving Word Search
pages.title: Thanksgiving Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable Thanksgiving word search full of the season's words — turkey, harvest, gratitude and the whole feast. A calm activity for the kids' table while dinner cooks, with an answer key on hand.
pages.tip: Edit the list to add your own family's dishes, or keep it as-is. Across-and-down at 10 x 10 works well for young solvers; add diagonals and backwards for a tougher puzzle.

pages.caption: Easter Word Search
pages.title: Easter Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable Easter word search hopping with springtime words — bunnies, baskets, eggs and chicks. A sweet, screen-free activity for the holiday, with a show-or-hide answer key.
pages.tip: Keep it gentle for preschoolers with an across-and-down 10 x 10 grid, or make it a real hunt with diagonals and backwards words turned on.

pages.caption: Valentine's Word Search
pages.title: Valentine's Day Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable Valentine's Day word search full of hearts, flowers and sweet words. Perfect for a classroom party or a lovey afternoon, and the answer key is a click away.
pages.tip: Make your own class set by editing the word list with your students' names. Easier for young kids with across-and-down; harder with diagonals and backwards words.

pages.caption: Animals Word Search
pages.title: Animals Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable animals word search hiding elephants, tigers, penguins and more across the grid. A fun, educational activity for young animal lovers, with an answer key ready to check.
pages.tip: Swap in ocean animals, farm animals, or your kid's favorites by editing the word list. Across-and-down keeps it easy; add diagonals and backwards for a challenge.

pages.caption: Space Word Search
pages.title: Space Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable space word search launching planets, rockets, comets and astronauts into the grid. A stellar activity for budding space fans, with a hide-or-show answer key.
pages.tip: Perfect for a space-themed classroom unit. Edit the list to add planet names or mission words, and dial the difficulty up with diagonals and backwards words.

pages.caption: Summer Word Search
pages.title: Summer Word Search
pages.blurb: A printable summer word search full of sunshine, beaches, popsicles and vacation words. A breezy activity for camp, road trips, or lazy afternoons, with an answer key on standby.
pages.tip: Print a stack for a summer camp or road trip. Keep it across-and-down for younger kids, or turn on diagonals and backwards words to slow down the fast solvers.
